verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation of ClickHouse's DDL locking behavior, deploy-request workflows, or branch-and-merge schema tooling; 'migration guides' (clickhouse-docs-7) refer only to migrating data from other platforms into ClickHouse Cloud, not schema-change safety. Community notes even describe ClickHouse as 'rigid-schema + append-only' with 'limited DELETE support' (clickhouse-comm-16, clickhouse-comm-19), reinforcing the absence of evidence for safe online schema evolution.
